mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lungs to the breathing apparatus was most worthwhile because the result explains how air moves in and out, bringing the construction together.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial rejection was confusing: the circulation item contained lungs, but could not yet combine with the pleural membranes.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the lungs could not be connected to the pleural membranes first; the chest interface had to be assembled before the lungs could join it.

arbitrary.text: The required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary because the first rejection did not explain why that connection was unavailable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the links between control, muscle movement and breathing were interesting, although I would hope later combinations explain their purpose as clearly as the final result.
